BusesRiders

    Every bus running a public route, from first pullout to last pull-in. Riders are boardings counted at the doors. One second is about 9 minutes. Sun, terrain shadows, cloud and rain are that day's, as recorded.

    Motion is reduced on this device, so this is a still from 5:15 PM.

    Vehicle positions from the UTS operations replay log (TransLoc AVL), sampled every 15 seconds. Aerial: USDA NAIP. Terrain: USGS 3DEP. Buildings and lighted paths: UVA GES, City of Charlottesville GIS. Cloud: GOES-East. Rain: NEXRAD. Night lights: NASA Black Marble. Streets © OpenStreetMap contributors.
